name: [Carto] New range content correctness
message:
@here The storefront is answering 200 but the new range is NOT on the site.

This test does not check availability — it checks CONTENT. The endpoint returns HTTP 200 in both the healthy and the broken case; the only difference is in the body. When the buying team's published range is missing, `$.complete` is false, `$.count` drops below the expected minimum and the named product is absent from the response.

That class of failure — nothing down, nothing slow, nothing erroring, revenue quietly not arriving — is invisible to every availability check in every tool. Detection has to assert on what the customer would actually see.

Next step: `GET /api/new-range` on the storefront, then the range publish job for the current trade week.
